Squall Cove

You run the cove from above. Send boats across the bay, launch Coast Guard craft, drop cargo, raise new islands or dig channels, and set the wind, rain, fog and time of day. Take the helm of any boat to sail it yourself.

DragMove the map Two fingersPinch to zoom, twist to turn SelectTap a boat, then tap open water to send it PlaceTap to place LandTap to dab the island.
